_help: Events shown in 'Events and Expos' on the home page and the events list on the Careers page.
Required: id (lowercase, dashes), title, eventType (short label such as Roundtable), startDate (YYYY-MM-DD), city.
Optional: endDate (YYYY-MM-DD, multi-day events), venue, url (https:// link to the organiser's page), organiser, featured (true/false).
Past events drop off automatically. Suggestions sent through the website's 'Submit your event' form are stored for review; copy approved ones here.
In demo mode the site uses demoFixture instead (fictional events with dates relative to today).
